description: Shared parity fixtures for the three result-document readers: runner.py _looks_like_result_document (refuses a release_assets file), collect_scores.py download_result_asset plus validate_result (schema check), and download.go isResultDocument. `body_base64` is the exact asset bytes (base64 so invalid UTF-8 can be represented). `is_result_document` is what every reader must conclude; `runner_attaches` is whether the runner may publish the file as a release asset. A case with is_result_document true must have runner_attaches false, or a file the runner uploads under the bot identity could be renamed to result.json and read as a score. Consumed by test_contract_parity.py, download_test.go, and nothing in the web (the browser never reads the asset).

cases.name: other schema
cases.note: A student report that happens to be JSON with a schema key.

cases.name: future result version
cases.note: No reader accepts it yet; the runner still refuses anything under the prefix.

cases.name: case-variant key
cases.note: encoding/json would match this to a `schema` struct field; json.loads would not.

cases.name: duplicate key, sentinel last
cases.note: Both parsers keep the last duplicate.

cases.name: duplicate key, sentinel first
cases.note: Both parsers keep the last duplicate.

cases.name: invalid UTF-8 inside a string
cases.note: Go's decoder would swallow the byte; a strict decode rejects it. The runner decodes with replacement so the sentinel is still seen and refused.

cases.name: sentinel nested in an array
cases.note: Only a top-level object is a document.
